title: Where to? nach, in, ans, zu

content.instructions: For towns, most countries and continents use “nach”, with no article: “nach Italien, nach Wien”. Countries with an article (“die Schweiz, die Türkei, die USA”) use “in” + accusative: “in die Schweiz”. For the sea and the mountains use “ans Meer” (an das) and “in die Berge”. For a person or an office use “zu”.
